description:
Title: Ordering in an Online Shop  

A customer that logs into an E-Shop system and has to wait for its login confirmation (its credentials are checked by the system).
If the login was successful then the customer can continue to select products, else the shopping experience stops.
After selecting a product the customer has to add it to a shopping cart, save the product and check if every product was already selected.
These steps repeat until all products were selected.
Then the order is finished by the shopping system and simultaneously payment and shipment for the order is prepared.
For the payment the customer has to enter its payment data and has to wait until the bank confirms the payment.
While waiting for the payment confirmation the customer can enter its shipping address (an independent billing address can be entered if the shipping address is not equal to the billing address).
Finally if the address and the payment steps are executed then the order will be finished by the system.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_OnlineShop" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/online-shop-ordering">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_PaymentConfirmed" name="Payment confirmed"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_OnlineShop">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_OnlineShop" name="Online shop ordering" processRef="Process_OnlineShop"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Bank" name="Bank"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PaymentConfirmed" name="Payment confirmed" sourceRef="Participant_Bank" targetRef="ICE_PaymentConfirmed"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_OnlineShop" name="Online shop ordering" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_OnlineShop">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Customer" name="Customer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Shopping</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_Login</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>GW_ProductMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_SelectProduct</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_AddToCart</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_SaveProduct</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_CheckAllSelected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>GW_AllSelected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_EnterPayment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>GW_PaySplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>ICE_PaymentConfirmed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_EnterShipping</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>GW_BillingQuestion</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_EnterBilling</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>GW_AddressMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>GW_PayJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_ShoppingStopped</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_EShop" name="E-Shop System">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_CheckCredentials</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>GW_CredentialsValid</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_FinishOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>GW_PrepSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_PreparePayment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_PrepareShipment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>GW_PrepJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_FinalizeOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_OrderFinished</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Shopping" name="Start shopping"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="T_Login" name="Log in to E-Shop system"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="T_CheckCredentials" name="Check credentials"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_CredentialsValid" name="Login successful?" default="SF_LoginFailed"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_ProductMerge" name="Next product"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="T_SelectProduct" name="Select product"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="T_AddToCart" name="Add product to shopping cart"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="T_SaveProduct" name="Save product"/>
    <bpmn:task id="T_CheckAllSelected" name="Check whether every product was selected"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_AllSelected" name="All products selected?" default="SF_AllSelected_Yes"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="T_FinishOrder" name="Finish order"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="GW_PrepSplit" name="Prepare payment and shipment"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="T_PreparePayment" name="Prepare payment"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="T_PrepareShipment" name="Prepare shipment"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="GW_PrepJoin" name="Payment and shipment prepared"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="T_EnterPayment" name="Enter payment data"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="GW_PaySplit" name="Split while awaiting payment confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="ICE_PaymentConfirmed" name="Payment confirmed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_PaymentConfirmed" messageRef="Msg_PaymentConfirmed"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="T_EnterShipping" name="Enter shipping address"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_BillingQuestion" name="Billing address differs from shipping address?" default="SF_BillingSame"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="T_EnterBilling" name="Enter independent billing address"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_AddressMerge" name="Address completed"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="GW_PayJoin" name="Payment and address completed"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="T_FinalizeOrder" name="Finalize order"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OrderFinished" name="Order finished"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ShoppingStopped" name="Shopping stopped"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_01" sourceRef="Start_Shopping" targetRef="T_Login"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_02" sourceRef="T_Login" targetRef="T_CheckCredentials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_03" sourceRef="T_CheckCredentials" targetRef="GW_CredentialsValid"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_LoginOK" name="Yes" sourceRef="GW_CredentialsValid" targetRef="GW_ProductMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${credentialsValid == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_LoginFailed" name="No" sourceRef="GW_CredentialsValid" targetRef="End_ShoppingStopped"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_04" sourceRef="GW_ProductMerge" targetRef="T_SelectProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_05" sourceRef="T_SelectProduct" targetRef="T_AddToCart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_06" sourceRef="T_AddToCart" targetRef="T_SaveProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_07" sourceRef="T_SaveProduct" targetRef="T_CheckAllSelected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_08" sourceRef="T_CheckAllSelected" targetRef="GW_AllSelected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_AllSelected_No" name="No" sourceRef="GW_AllSelected" targetRef="GW_ProductMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${allProductsSelected == false}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_AllSelected_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="GW_AllSelected" targetRef="T_FinishOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_09" sourceRef="T_FinishOrder" targetRef="GW_PrepSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_10" sourceRef="GW_PrepSplit" targetRef="T_PreparePayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_11" sourceRef="GW_PrepSplit" targetRef="T_PrepareShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_12" sourceRef="T_PreparePayment" targetRef="GW_PrepJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_13" sourceRef="T_PrepareShipment" targetRef="GW_PrepJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_14" sourceRef="GW_PrepJoin" targetRef="T_EnterPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_15" sourceRef="T_EnterPayment" targetRef="GW_PaySplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_16" sourceRef="GW_PaySplit" targetRef="ICE_PaymentConfirmed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_17" sourceRef="GW_PaySplit" targetRef="T_EnterShipping"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_18" sourceRef="ICE_PaymentConfirmed" targetRef="GW_PayJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_19" sourceRef="T_EnterShipping" targetRef="GW_BillingQuestion"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_BillingDiffers" name="Yes" sourceRef="GW_BillingQuestion" targetRef="T_EnterBilling">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${billingAddressDiffersFromShipping == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_BillingSame" name="No" sourceRef="GW_BillingQuestion" targetRef="GW_AddressMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_20" sourceRef="T_EnterBilling" targetRef="GW_AddressMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_21" sourceRef="GW_AddressMerge" targetRef="GW_PayJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_22" sourceRef="GW_PayJoin" targetRef="T_FinalizeOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_23" sourceRef="T_FinalizeOrder" targetRef="End_OrderFinished"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
